title: Jude and the Cipher
premise: When Juniper Vasquez receives a confession letter postmarked the day after a stranger's funeral, he realizes the dead man was never who the town believed — and that someone has been editing the coroner's own files to bury a decades-old crime. As a second body surfaces bearing details only the original killer could know, Juniper discovers the confession was mailed by someone still alive, someone using his own meticulous records as a map. To stop a killer who thinks in filing systems, Juniper must reconstruct a memory the town chose to forget — including his mother's role in it — before the final page of the cipher is filed under his own name.
about_author: Yara Vane is the pen name of a former records clerk who spent eleven years in municipal archives before turning to fiction, a background that saturates her mysteries with the quiet menace of paperwork. She lives in a coastal town where she claims the dead keep better secrets than the living.
